notes: Source read statically from src/actions.js, src/feedbacks.js, src/models.js, src/enum.js and src/common.js; nothing was executed. Presets (src/presets.js), variables (src/variables.js), config fields and upgrade scripts are not catalogued (the schema has no fields for them).

Model dependent: the module builds its action and feedback lists from the capability table of the model series (src/models.js: BASE_CAPABILITIES; 24 series specs, Other being the base set itself: Other, CX350, HE2, HE40, HE50, HE120, HE130, HR140, UBX100, UB300, UB10, UB50, UE5, UE4, UE20, UE50, UE70, UE80, UE100, UR100, UE150, UE150A, UE160, POVCAM). Each entry lists the models that register it in `availability`. The config option Camera Model defaults to Auto Detect (QID); an unknown detected model and the model "Other" use the Other series (base capabilities). Not the same module as `panasonic-ptz`.

Protocol: HTTP via the got library. PTZ commands go to /cgi-bin/aw_ptz?cmd=%23<cmd>&res=1, camera commands to /cgi-bin/aw_cam?cmd=<cmd>&res=1, web commands (sdctrl, srt_ctrl, ts_ctrl, rtmp_ctrl, initial?cmd=reset) to /cgi-bin/<cmd>. Status updates come from an event subscription over a local TCP port (default 31004, config tcpPort) or from polling. Config defaults: HTTP port 80, timeout 2000 ms.

Base library @companion-module/base ~2.1.2: option values may be expressions. Many number and preset fields set allowInvalidValues and the module constrains expression results into the valid range; an unreadable value sends no command.

Option ids of the stepped actions (op, set, step): op ids are the string s (set) and the numbers 1 / -1 (increase/decrease, raise/lower, next/previous), plus t (toggle) as a string on enum actions. Dropdown ids of enum lists are strings (hex digits or digits). Numeric defaults and the choice id types are recorded as written in the source (for example the Lens direction ids 0, 1, -1 are numbers, the Pan/Tilt direction ids are strings).

Where the dropdown list depends on the model series (gain, shutter, filter, OIS, chroma level, DNR, DRS, white balance, color temperature, preset velocity), the options carry choicesNote with the per-series lists instead of a closed `choices` list; lists generated by arithmetic in src/enum.js are described as patterns. Where the default is the first entry of a model list and that differs between models, no default is recorded.

Level actions (chromaPhase, ped, pedRed/Blue/Green, gainRed/Blue/Green, audioVolumeLevel) have ranges that differ per model; min/max record the widest range and the per-series ranges are in the option description. The source option flag `range: true` (slider) and `expressionDescription` texts are not recorded.

Some entries are one registered id with a model dependent shape: `tally` (name System - Red Tally or System - Tally), `gain` (UB10/UB50 get only Increase/Decrease), `colorTemperature` (index lists or advanced Kelvin range); these are marked optionsComplete false or described in `description`.

Provenance of lens actions (zoom, zoomControl, zoomSpeed, focus, focusControl, focusSpeed) points to their definition inside the lensAxis helper in src/actions.js; level and position actions point to the assignment line.
